🫏 New post ready 📚 List · friendship · 8 slides “things we did at ten that take nerve now” 📝 Slides
1. things we did at ten that take nerve now 2. walking up your front steps and knocking on the door without texting first to see if you were home. 3. asking 'do you want to be friends?' out loud before we even knew each other's last names. 4. opening your fridge to grab a juice box without asking anyone in the kitchen. 5. telling your mum i was staying for dinner before i even checked with my own. 6. saying i'm sorry five minutes after we flipped the board game across the rug. 7. promising we would buy two houses right next door to each other and never move away. 8. save this for the friend whose childhood phone number you still know by heart.
✍️ Caption
we spent whole summers together without ever having to make a plan. now we look at each other's photos and wonder when we got so polite. save this for an afternoon when you miss your childhood best friend.
